notes.content:
[h1]CONTROLLER SUPPORT ADDED[/h1]

You can enable controller support in the settings, and you'll be able to play with your [b]gamepad[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44772999/06326024c15b2775cd9d5acc27a1e2861782482b.png[/img]

[h2]WIDE SCREEN OPTIMIZATION[/h2]

Goe is now [b]playable[/b] on the wide screens.

notes.title: Patch Notes 1.1 | First Week Patch
notes.content:
Hello challengers , we are here with our first update! A few technical fixes and some enhancements have been made. Here are the patch notes: 

[h2]Thess Available![/h2]

The issue with Thess not unlocking has been fixed, and the difficulty of the objective required to unlock this assassin orc hero has been reduced. You'll need to be quick with your fingers to master this hero!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44772999/04bc5a4f3ed37cb03794cbd6dac41f04a691a4eb.gif[/img]

[h2]Balance[/h2]

We noticed that players were having difficulty with the second map, so we made some changes. Without significantly altering the base stats, we have applied some nerfs to the elemental debuffs.

[h1]Other Notes:[/h1]

[list]
[*]The language option has been fixed.
[*]A button has been added to access the evolution menu tutorial again.
[*]The infinite elemental resistance and health bug for Eywriis has been resolved.
[*]The bug where the archer boss's arrows remained on the map has been fixed.
[*]Small buffs have been applied to the heroes.
[*]Some audio bugs fixed.
[/list]

notes.title: Gems Of Evolution Early Access Releasing Now!
notes.content:
Gems Of Evolution early access releasing now with 4 heroes and 2 maps! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44772999/6fc790f397abe318a88bcc502eee96eaca85e740.gif[/img]

There are several important reasons why we are releasing our game in Early Access:

Community Feedback: We want to continuously improve the Gems Of Evolution(Goe) by directly receiving feedback from our players. Early Access allows us to develop the Goe based on the views and suggestions of our community, providing a more enjoyable and balanced experience.

Stability and Balancing: Continuous testing is needed to optimize Goe mechanics and features. Early Access enables players with different profiles to experience the Goe, testing various scenarios and strategies.

Heroes and Mechanics Development: There are many heroes and mechanics we want to add to the game. During Early Access, we can gradually introduce these heroes and mechanics, and make adjustments based on player feedback.

Building a Community: Early Access is a great opportunity to build a strong and engaged community around our game. By fostering a closer relationship with our players, we aim to increase their interest and commitment to the Goe.

We believe that with the contributions of our valuable players during the Early Access period, we can make our game even better. Thank you for joining us and for your support. 

Don't forget to join our Discord channel, we're excited to connect and improve Goe with you!
